scope: 60-second synthetic source: default regression 4 runs and controlled cold/warm input 8 runs. Not the 10/60-minute cache matrix, real speech, or OS-wide cold-cache. All app/oracle/output criteria unchanged.
auditorSource:
from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, math, datetime, sys
base=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); baseline=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(); root=Path.cwd()
assert sys.argv[3:]==['--same-product'], 'Explicit same-product comparison is required'
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def sha(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(p).open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
def content(p):return {k:v for k,v in p.items() if k!='savedAt'}
def normalize(v):
 if isinstance(v,dict):return {k:normalize(x) for k,x in v.items() if k not in ['path','savedAt','visualReview']}
 if isinstance(v,list):return [normalize(x) for x in v]
 return v
r=read(base/'results.json');old=read(baseline/'results.json')
allowed_harness_changes={'scripts/composition-benchmark.mjs','scripts/helpers/file-cache.mjs','scripts/helpers/file-cache.c'}
assert {k:v for k,v in r['sourceHashes'].items() if k not in allowed_harness_changes}=={k:v for k,v in old['sourceHashes'].items() if k not in allowed_harness_changes}, 'Product or oracle sources changed'
assert sha(baseline/'executed-benchmark.mjs')==old['sourceHashes']['scripts/composition-benchmark.mjs']
assert r['status'] in ['completed','failed'] and r['runs']
for f,digest in r['sourceHashes'].items():assert sha(root/f)==digest, f
for f,digest in r['packageSourceHashes'].items():assert digest==r['sourceHashes'][f]
for a,b in [('executed-benchmark.mjs','scripts/composition-benchmark.mjs'),('executed-server.mjs','scripts/benchmark-server.mjs')]:assert sha(base/a)==r['sourceHashes'][b]
for f in r['fixtures']:
 assert sha(f['source'])==f['media']['fingerprint'];assert sha(f['effectFile'])==f['effectFingerprint']
a={'date':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'AUDITED_'+r['status'].upper(),'code':r['code'],'scope':'Entire projects, actual file hashes, independent output verification, UI samples, simultaneous raw RSS sums and cancellation/retry audited. Comparisons retain all oracle values; path and savedAt are excluded only where appropriate. Only the explicitly listed input-cache control harness may differ; product, oracle, client bundle, and package sources must match. MP4/SRT/verification are compared for the same product, to the same surface/duration where available or another surface at the same duration. If baseline equals this report the first run is only an internal consistency check, not independent validation of itself; the executed benchmark supplies the independent oracle checks. Full decoded comparisons are separate. No human speech-quality or OS cold-cache claim.','baseline':str(baseline),'runs':[],'cancellations':r['cancellations']}
for run in r['runs']:
 it=run['iteration'];surface=run['surface'];seconds=run['inputSeconds'];prefix=f'{surface}-{seconds}-{it}'
 # A prior failure may have prevented the same ordinal from running. Compare with
 # the last completed baseline output for the same surface and duration instead.
 candidates=[x for x in old['runs'] if x['surface']==surface and x['inputSeconds']==seconds]
 if not candidates:candidates=[x for x in old['runs'] if x['inputSeconds']==seconds]
 assert candidates
 prev=candidates[0] if base==baseline else next((x for x in candidates if x['iteration']==it),candidates[-1])
 v=read(base/run['verificationFile']);pv=read(baseline/prev['verificationFile'])
 assert v['frames']['status']=='PASS' and v['sync']['status']=='PASS'
 assert v['frames']['frames']==v['video']['frames']
 assert v['frames']['maxClockError']<=v['frames']['toleranceSeconds']
 assert v['srt']['cues']==run['captions']==len(v['expected']['captions'])
 assert v['srt']['maxErrorSeconds']<=0.001
 assert len(v['audio']['events'])==run['effects']==len(v['expected']['effects'])
 assert sha(prev['outputFile'])==prev['outputSHA256']
 assert sha(prev['srtFile'])==prev['srtSHA256']
 compared_v=dict(v);compared_pv=dict(pv)
 compared_v.pop('outputSHA256');compared_pv.pop('outputSHA256')
 assert normalize(compared_v)==normalize(compared_pv), 'independent verification differs'
 assert sha(run['outputFile'])==run['outputSHA256']==v['outputSHA256']
 assert run['outputSHA256']==prev['outputSHA256'], 'Same-build bitstream differs; investigate before asserting equivalence'
 assert sha(run['srtFile'])==run['srtSHA256']==prev['srtSHA256']
 for frame in v['video']['framesForVisualReview']:assert sha(frame['path'])==frame['sha256']
 projects=[read(base/f'{prefix}-{kind}.json') for kind in ['input-project','project','after-ui-project']]
 assert content(projects[0])==content(projects[1])==content(projects[2])
 assert run['sourcePreserved'] and run['effectPreserved'] and run['projectPreserved']
 assert run['pageErrors']==[] and run['externalRequests']==0
 all_peaks=[];max_gap=0;peak_info=None
 for phase,summary in run['resources'].items():
  res=read(base/summary['file']);assert res['errors']==[]
  samples=res['samples'];assert len(samples)==summary['samples']
  for x in samples:assert x['bytes']==sum(p['bytes'] for p in x['processes'])
  top=max(samples,key=lambda x:x['bytes']);assert top['bytes']==res['peakBytes']==summary['peakBytes']
  gap=max([b['milliseconds']-a['milliseconds'] for a,b in zip(samples,samples[1:])] or [0]);assert math.isclose(gap,summary['maxSampleGapMs'],abs_tol=1e-7)
  all_peaks.append(top['bytes']);max_gap=max(max_gap,gap)
  if peak_info is None or top['bytes']>peak_info['bytes']:peak_info={'phase':phase,**top}
 assert max(all_peaks)==run['peakRSSBytes']
 for family,summary in run['ui']['byFamily'].items():
  vals=sorted(x['ms'] for x in run['ui']['samples'] if x['family']==family);assert len(vals)==32==summary['count']
  assert vals[30]==summary['p95'] and vals[-1]==summary['max']
 expected={'analysis':run['analyzeSeconds']<=seconds*.2,'export':run['exportSeconds']<=seconds,'memory':run['peakRSSBytes']<=2*1024**3,'ui':all(x['p95']<=200 for x in run['ui']['byFamily'].values())}
 assert run['goals']==expected
 a['runs'].append({'surface':surface,'seconds':seconds,'iteration':it,'baselineIteration':prev['iteration'],'baselineSurface':prev['surface'],'comparisonToSelf':base==baseline and run['surface']==prev['surface'] and it==prev['iteration'],'analyzeSeconds':run['analyzeSeconds'],'exportSeconds':run['exportSeconds'],'independentVerificationSeconds':run['independentVerificationSeconds'],'peakGiB':run['peakRSSBytes']/1024**3,'ui':run['ui']['byFamily'],'maxSampleGapMs':max_gap,'goals':expected,'wholeProjectPreserved':True,'actualOutputHashMatchesReport':True,'outputBytesEqualToBaseline':True,'srtBytesEqualToBaseline':True,'outputSHA256':run['outputSHA256'],'independentCorrectnessEqual':True,'visualSampleHashesEqual':True,'peakSample':peak_info})
for c in r['cancellations']:
 for key in ['deleteCancelled','projectPreserved','savedOutputPreserved','displayedOutputPreserved']:assert c[key]
 assert c['jobStatus']=='cancelled'
 assert c['displayPass']==(c['displayMs']<=300) and c['readyPass']==(c['readyMs']<=5000)
 prefix=f"{c['surface']}-{c['inputSeconds']}-1"
 assert content(read(base/f'{prefix}-cancel-project.json'))==content(read(base/f'{prefix}-input-project.json'))
 if c['retryCompletedIteration'] is not None:assert any(x['surface']==c['surface'] and x['inputSeconds']==c['inputSeconds'] and x['iteration']==c['retryCompletedIteration'] for x in r['runs'])
if r['status']=='completed':
 assert r['measuredGoalsPass'] and r['failures']==[]
 for seconds in r['requested']['durations']:
  for surface in r['requested']['surfaces']:
   assert sorted(x['iteration'] for x in r['runs'] if x['surface']==surface and x['inputSeconds']==seconds)==list(range(1,r['requested']['iterations']+1))
 assert all(all(x['goals'].values()) for x in r['runs'])
 assert len(r['cancellations'])==len(r['requested']['durations'])*len(r['requested']['surfaces'])
 assert all(c['retryCompletedIteration']==2 and c['displayPass'] and c['readyPass'] for c in r['cancellations'])
else:
 assert r['failures'];a['failures']=[{k:f[k] for k in ['surface','inputSeconds','iteration','phase','error']} for f in r['failures']]
a['auditSourceSHA256']=sha(__file__)

a['harnessSourceChanges']={k:{'before':old['sourceHashes'].get(k),'after':r['sourceHashes'].get(k)} for k in sorted(allowed_harness_changes) if old['sourceHashes'].get(k)!=r['sourceHashes'].get(k)}
mode=r['requested']['inputCache'];assert mode in ['uncontrolled','cold','warm']
a['inputCacheMode']=mode;a['inputCacheChecks']=[]
if mode=='uncontrolled':
 assert 'inputFileCache' not in r and all(x['inputFileCache'] is None for x in r['runs'])
else:
 state=r['inputFileCache'];directory=Path(state['directory'])
 assert sha(directory/'executed-file-cache.c')==state['sourceSHA256']==r['sourceHashes']['scripts/helpers/file-cache.c']
 assert sha(directory/'file-cache-tool')==state['binarySHA256']
 if r['status']=='completed':assert state['attempts']==[x['inputFileCache'] for x in r['runs']]
 for run in r['runs']:
  c=run['inputFileCache'];assert c['mode']==mode and c['status']=='completed'
  assert read(directory/(c['prefix']+'.json'))==c
  assert sha(c['file'])==sha(c['source'])==c['expectedSHA256']==c['actualSHA256']==c['endOfRunSHA256']
  assert Path(c['file']).name==Path(c['source']).name
  expected_commands=['copy','inspect','inspect'] if mode=='cold' else ['copy','warm','inspect','inspect']
  calls=c['calls'];assert [x['command'] for x in calls]==expected_commands
  for call in calls:assert call['startedMs']<=call['completedMs'] and 'error' not in call
  for previous,current in zip(calls,calls[1:]):assert previous['completedMs']<=current['startedMs']
  pre=c['beforeSelection'];assert pre==calls[-2]['observations'][0]
  assert c['afterAnalysis']==calls[-1]['observations'][0]
  for call in calls:
   for ob in call['observations']:
    if 'residentPages' not in ob:continue
    assert all(type(ob[k]) is int for k in ['bytes','pages','pageBytes','residentPages'])
    assert ob['bytes']>0 and ob['pageBytes']>0 and ob['pages']==math.ceil(ob['bytes']/ob['pageBytes'])
    assert 0<=ob['residentPages']<=ob['pages']
  assert pre['bytes']==Path(c['file']).stat().st_size==calls[0]['observations'][0]['bytes']
  assert pre['residentPages']==(0 if mode=='cold' else pre['pages'])
  if mode=='cold':assert calls[0]['observations'][-1]['residentPages']==0
  else:assert calls[1]['observations'][-1]['residentPages']==pre['pages']
  assert c['inspectionCompletedMs']==calls[-2]['completedMs']<=c['selectionActionMs']<=c['analysisCompletedMs']<=calls[-1]['startedMs']
  assert math.isclose(c['observationReturnToSelectionMs'],c['selectionActionMs']-c['inspectionCompletedMs'],abs_tol=1e-7)
  a['inputCacheChecks'].append({'surface':run['surface'],'seconds':run['inputSeconds'],'iteration':run['iteration'],'mode':mode,'bytes':pre['bytes'],'pages':pre['pages'],'residentPages':pre['residentPages'],'observationReturnToSelectionMs':c['observationReturnToSelectionMs'],'preparationMs':c['preparationMs'],'actualInputHashVerified':True,'postAnalysisAndEndOfRunInputPreserved':True})

(base/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
for x in a['runs']: print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in x.items() if k not in ['peakSample','ui']},ensure_ascii=False))
print(json.dumps({'status':a['status'],'cancellations':a['cancellations']},ensure_ascii=False))

decodedEquivalenceReference.basis: Every actual MP4 hash is the same candidate file already compared over all 1448 decoded frames/PTS and whole float32 PCM; identical files are not decoded again.
